concrete_scene.heading: Worked receipt-to-refusal trace: the 128-channel block-cyclic candidate
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A cyclic-substrate adoption gate evaluating one recorded Circle mixer candidate
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Decide whether exact dense-reference parity and a 128-versus-2,048 parameter count can authorize model routing or canary deployment.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The structural gate accepts max_abs_dense_delta equal to zero and a 0.0625 block-to-dense parameter ratio, while the adoption gate refuses route and canary authority.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The trace tests whether a finite parity receipt and 16-fold parameter reduction can substitute for workload quality, kernel, memory, optimization, and fallback evidence; they cannot.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: The cyclic-mechanism evaluation campaign owns matched baselines, real hardware costs, quality and stability measures, negative controls, and fallback execution.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The receipt supports only structural parity and finite parameter accounting for the pinned fixture; it establishes no trained-model quality, runtime, memory, context, or deployment result.

worked_trace.heading: Worked receipt-to-refusal trace: the 128-channel block-cyclic candidate
worked_trace.maximum_inference: The pinned fixture establishes exact dense-reference parity and finite parameter accounting only; route, canary, model-quality, hardware-efficiency, and deployment decisions remain blocked.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: A parameter-count-only baseline would declare a 16-fold reduction and stop. The chapter keeps structural, resource, and empirical ledgers separate and refuses adoption while the latter two are incomplete.
readable_claim: A cyclic mechanism becomes an architectural option only when its structural receipt, workload behavior, hardware cost, and fallback decision can be inspected separately.
normative_rule: Spend proof or receipt evidence only on the structural axis it checks. Require matched ordinary baselines, quality and cost measures, failure cases, and a tested fallback before a cyclic candidate can change a route or enter a canary.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The scene states the one structural conclusion it permits and the workload, kernel, memory, optimization, and fallback conclusions it blocks.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Detailed receipt fingerprints and distinct non-claims remain in the recorded receipt boundaries, chapter status, and formal evidence surfaces.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The four-step decision list remains because it shows the adoption path; exact theorem IDs, fingerprints, validator inventories, and mutation counts remain in the evidence sections.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The new reader projection separates structural use, empirical admission, and fallback from the retained exact formal packet.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The worked trace consolidates the common non-performance boundary without erasing mechanism-specific limits elsewhere.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: No new bookkeeping table was added; the numerical trace is carried by prose and a decision sequence.

non_claims: The trace does not establish trained-model quality or context-length improvement.
The trace does not establish hardware speed, memory benefit, or deployment readiness.
The editorial revision does not move chapter-core support or release state.
